offering: A no-code builder for progressive web apps (PWAs) with payments, push notifications and member content.
summary: TapAndLaunch is a no-code builder for progressive web apps, aimed at restaurants, gyms, shops, venues, clubs and communities. Users start from a template, arrange pages with a drag-and-drop editor against a live phone preview, and publish to a TapAndLaunch address or their own domain; customers open the app from a link or QR code and add it to their home screen. It includes push notifications and email, members-only or paid-tier content, and card payments through the customer's own Stripe account, with a 30-day free trial and a $10/month plan.

disqualifiers: Requires a native listing in the App Store or Google Play
Has an in-house mobile engineering team
